name: Heeding the Call
summary: Mathrengyl Bearwalker awaits you in Darnassus, where he calls you to learn the ways of the bear. This is your first step toward serving nature and preserving balance.

sections.title: A Call in Darnassus
sections.body: In the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus, Mathrengyl Bearwalker welcomes you and calls you to take a first step into a wider world. He teaches that Cenarius' children are called to serve nature, with animals and plants both friends and charges. You begin by learning the ways of the bear and the strength of body and heart.

faq.q: Who is asking me to come here?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker awaits you in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.

faq.q: Where do I find Mathrengyl Bearwalker?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker is in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.

faq.q: What does Mathrengyl want me to learn?
faq.answer: He calls you to learn the ways of the bear and strength of body and heart.

faq.q: What is the call of Cenarius' children?
faq.answer: Cenarius' children are called to serve nature and preserve balance for the sake of plants and animals, as well as their own.

angles.text: As a druid, Mathrengyl calls you to learn the ways of the bear and serve nature by preserving balance.

attribution: In-game quest text: Heeding the Call
